REVIEW PREPARATION - NOT SUBMITTED
App: Body Intelligence Log, com.bilhealth.bodyintelligencelog, version 1.0.0. Source under audit: 6bf23994712ffbdcb2d8179defec5852e5d08ae1. No build is attached to this draft. Build 35 was the previously reviewed binary; TestFlight build 36 is not proof of the current source. These notes do not claim that the previous rejection is resolved.

ACCESS AND PURCHASE REVIEW
Use the demo credentials saved in App Review Information with ordinary email/password sign-in. Full paid-feature access and purchase-flow review are separate checks. Before submission, verify every paid route on the replacement binary and add an expired-subscription demo account for review of the purchase flow. No new credentials are included in these notes.
Plans: in More, tap Explore Premium (Free) or Active (paid). Products: bil_premium, bil_premium_annual, bil_premium_ai_coach, bil_premium_ai_coach_annual and consumable bil_ai_boost. StoreKit provides product details and purchase sheets. Eligible purchases have a restore path. Sandbox purchase, verification, restore, relaunch and expiry evidence must match the attached replacement; product state READY_TO_SUBMIT is not purchase acceptance.
Paid routes include Goals and its additional nutrition settings, nutrition analytics, weekly reports, nutrition plans, recipes/workouts and Connected Health. Unknown entitlement verification should offer retry rather than treating the user as confirmed Free.

AI, SPEECH AND HEALTH DATA
AI Coach is under AI Coach; settings are under AI Coach settings. Before remote AI processing the app identifies Google Gemini and requests explicit permission for the question, selected context categories and up to 12 recent conversation turns. Declining keeps local features available. AI consent can be withdrawn in AI Coach settings.
Meal-photo analysis has a separate consent step; the selected image, language and necessary request metadata are used to suggest foods for review. Suggestions are not logged without confirmation. Meal-photo permission can be withdrawn in Sharing & Privacy.
Voice uses the OS speech recognizer; its provider may process microphone audio. The BIL speech bridge exposes recognized text, not raw audio uploads to BIL or Gemini. Microphone/speech permissions and remote-AI consent are separate.
Health connections and weight export require their own explicit permissions. Sources & Methodology explains calculation limits. BIL is a wellness app, not a medical device or treatment service.

NOTIFICATIONS, PRIVACY AND SAFETY
Daily reminders and notification preferences are optional in More > Reminders. Community push previews default off. Device permission denial must preserve normal app use. Blocking, reporting and Community Guidelines are available in Community; account deletion is in Help.
The advertising source requests non-personalized banners only after adult Free-account eligibility and live Google UMP readiness; it disables publisher first-party ID. These source settings do not establish absence of SDK tracking. Do not treat UMP as ATT authorization.

PREVIOUS 5.1.2(i) REJECTION - SUBMISSION HOLD
Build 35 was rejected for App Privacy tracking declarations without ATT. Final App Privacy answers must match the replacement archive, partner SDKs and actual data practices on all applicable platforms. The source privacy manifest alone is insufficient. Do not submit until tracking/ATT reconciliation, AI consent refusal/withdrawal, reviewer routes, sandbox purchases and screenshot correspondence are verified on the intended replacement. No review submission or release is requested by these preparation notes.
description:
Body Intelligence Log (BIL) brings daily nutrition, body trends, activity, and habits into one clear, explainable experience.

Log meals by search, barcode, voice, or photo when the related service is available. Review calories, macros, nutrients, hydration, weight trends, activity, sleep, and weekly reports based on information you record or explicitly connect.

With your permission, BIL can import supported fitness and wellness data from Apple Health and compatible fitness watches or scales. Imported readings retain their source. BIL can export weight records to Apple Health only when you explicitly enable weight export and grant Health write permission.

BIL distinguishes recorded or measured data from calculated estimates and general population references. The in-app Sources & Methodology section explains relevant references, calculation methods, and limitations.

Explore food catalogs, nutrition plans, 1,500 recipes, 300+ workout videos, fasting tools, community features, and optional AI Coach guidance where available.

Remote AI Coach answers are generated using Google Gemini, a third-party AI service operated by Google. Before the first remote AI request, BIL explains what may be sent and requires your explicit consent. The request includes your question, the relevant context you select, and up to 12 recent conversation turns; Google Gemini processes it to generate a response. Voice dictation may be processed by the speech-recognition provider selected in your device settings. Raw microphone recordings are not sent to BIL’s backend or Google Gemini. You can decline, keep using local features, and withdraw AI consent later.

Meal-photo analysis has a separate consent step before an image is selected or sent to Google Gemini. Suggested foods are never logged until you review and confirm them.

Notifications are optional. Choose reminders and manage Community notification preferences from Reminders in More. Device notification permission is separate from AI and health-data permissions.

Community, friends, and private messages are available to signed-in users. Community Guidelines, privacy controls, blocking, reporting, and server-backed moderation tools help support a safer community experience.

Premium subscriptions and BIL AI Boost are optional In-App Purchases. Core logging works locally and offline. Features requiring network access clearly report when they are unavailable. In-App Purchases are activated after App Store verification, and eligible purchases can be restored.

BIL offers 25 language options and is designed to clearly identify missing information, data sources, and calculated estimates rather than presenting unavailable information as measured data.

Body Intelligence Log is a wellness and fitness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions. Calculated estimates and wellness information are not treatment prescriptions. Consult a doctor or qualified health professional before making decisions involving pregnancy, supplements, medicines, or medical conditions.
